[ASSISTANT_SAID] Making the switch to a reusable razor is a great decision for the environment and wallet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended reusable razors include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. **Safety Razors:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Merkur HD (around $40): A classic, high-quality option with a single-edge blade. Great for beginners and experienced users alike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Muhle R41 (around $50): A popular, well-balanced safety razor with a comfortable handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. **Cartridge Razors with Replaceable Blades:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Harry's Razor (around $20): A modern, ergonomic design with affordable, recyclable blades.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Billie Razor (around $20): A popular, affordable option with a comfortable grip and easy blade replacement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. **Straight Razors:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Parker SR1 (around $30): A beginner-friendly, stainless steel straight razor with a comfortable handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Wusthof Classic Ikon (around $100): A high-end, precision-engineered straight razor with a beautiful wooden handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. **Shavette-Style Razors:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Muhle RYM (around $30): A unique, adjustable razor with a replaceable blade and comfortable handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - iKon Shavette (around $25): A budget-friendly, lightweight shavette-style razor with a replaceable blade.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When choosing a reusable razor, consider factors like blade type, comfort, ease of use, price, and brand reputation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested reading reviews, watching videos, or asking friends for recommendations.
